caption: The drawing depicts a fireplace with a wooden mantel and an overmantel cabinet. The overall structure is rectangular and symmetrical, with vertical fluted columns on each side of both the mantel and overmantel. The mantel features a broad horizontal top with a diamond-shaped decorative inset in the front center. Beneath the mantel is the firebox, which is lined on its interior with reddish-brown bricks, and two ornate metal andirons are placed inside. The hearth extends outward and is also constructed of reddish-brown brick. The overmantel cabinet above the mantel has a similar diamond-shaped decorative element and a large central wood panel that appears to be composed of two doors or sections, framed by the same fluted vertical columns present below. The entire fireplace structure is colored in natural wood tones of light brown and beige, contrasting with the brickwork of the firebox and hearth. The drawing is set against a plain light beige background with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Carved Casing
